# STATUS: reference snapshot; NOT wired into NosAi runtime

DotRecast is a C# port of Recast & Detour. Relevant modules include navmesh generation, runtime navmesh queries/pathfinding, tiled navmesh streaming, crowd movement/collision avoidance, and dynamic navmesh support.

NosAi relevance:
- deterministic navigation/path planning;
- hierarchical/tiled navigation for larger maps;
- movement feasibility checks;
- future crowd/avoidance simulation.

The upstream license requires preservation of origin/notice and clear marking of altered source versions. This local file is a research synopsis; source code is not copied here.
